sample_unit: phenotypically balanced cases rated by five dermatologists

links.outcome: Worst-group diagnostic accuracy across Fitzpatrick skin tones on Fitz17k and DDI
links.effect: SkinGPT-R1 achieved worst-group performance of 41.40% on Fitz17k and a five-fold relative improvement in lower-bound accuracy on DDI versus standard multimodal baselines.
links.quote: Critically, SkinGPT-R1 effectively mitigates algorithmic bias across the full Fitzpatrick skin tone spectrum, achieving a robust worst-group performance of 41.40% on the Fitz17k benchmark and a five-fold relative improvement in lower-bound accuracy on the DDI dataset relative to standard multimodal baselines.

unlisted_practices: Fairness-aware mixture-of-experts architecture for skin tone equity
Chain-of-thought diagnostic reasoning to produce interpretable reports

screen.reason: Evaluates a newly developed multimodal reasoning model (SkinGPT-R1) for dermatological diagnosis across skin tones using external benchmark datasets and a blinded expert reader study, but does not test a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
